articles.title: 14-day versus 28-day trifluridine-tipiracil plus bevacizumab for refractory metastatic colorectal cancer (PRABITAS): a pragmatic, multicentre, open-label, randomised, phase 3, non-inferiority trial in Japan
articles.authors: Sakakida T, Taniguchi H, Asayama M, Suwa Y, Shimura T, Mitani S, Makiyama A, Arai H, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Trifluridine-tipiracil (FTD-TPI) plus bevacizumab is the standard treatment for refractory metastatic colorectal cancer. However, the conventional schedule is frequently associated with haematological and gastrointestinal toxicity, which is clinically significant and relevant to patients. A simplified 14-day schedule has been proposed to reduce toxicity, but whether this treatment preserves survival has not been established in a randomised trial. We therefore aimed to assess whether the 14-day schedule is non-inferior to the conventional schedule for overall survival.
abstract.textZh: Trifluridine-tipiracil (FTD-TPI)加上貝伐珠單抗是難治性轉移性大腸直腸癌的標準治療。然而，傳統排程通常與血液學和胃腸道毒性有關，這在臨牀上具有顯著意義，並且與患者有關。已經提出了簡化的14天時間表來降低毒性，但在隨機試驗中尚未確定這種治療能否保住生存期。因此，我們的目標是評估14天的計劃是否不劣於整體生存的傳統計劃。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: PRABITAS was a pragmatic, multicentre, open-label, randomised, phase 3, non-inferiority trial conducted in 178 hospitals in Japan. Patients with refractory metastatic colorectal cancer were randomly assigned (1:1) using a minimisation algorithm, stratified by Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group performance status, RAS mutational status, and institution, to FTD-TPI (35 mg/m2 orally twice daily) plus bevacizumab (5 mg/kg intravenously) on either a conventional 28-day (FTD-TPI on days 1-5 and 8-12; bevacizumab on days 1 and 15) or 14-day schedule (FTD-TPI on days 1-5; bevacizumab on day 1). Eligibility criteria were broadened compared with those of conventional explanatory trials, and trial procedures were aligned with routine clinical practice. The primary endpoint was overall survival, analysed in the intention-to-treat population, with a prespecified non-inferiority margin of 1·25. Safety was assessed in all patients who received at least one dose. Missing data were not imputed. This trial is registered with the Japan Registry of Clinical Trials, jRCTs041230120, and is closed to enrolment.
abstract.textZh: PRABITAS是一項務實、多中心、開放標籤、隨機、3期、非劣效性試驗，在日本178家醫院進行。 難治性轉移性大腸直腸癌患者使用由東部腫瘤合作組體能狀態、RAS突變狀態和機構分層的最小化演算法(1: 1) ，在傳統的28天(第1-5天和第8-12天為FTD-TPI ；第1-5天為FTD-TPI ；第1天為貝伐珠單抗)或14天(第1-5天為FTD-TPI ；第1天為貝伐珠單抗)中隨機分配FTD-TPI (35 mg/m2 ，每日口服兩次)加上貝伐珠單抗(5 mg/kg ，靜脈注射)。 與傳統的解釋性試驗相比，資格標準得到擴大，試驗程序與常規臨牀實踐一致。 主要終點是總生存期，在意向治療族羣中進行分析，預先指定的非劣效性邊界為1.25。 在所有接受至少一劑藥物的患者中評估安全性。 缺失的數據未被估算。 本試驗已在日本臨牀試驗註冊處（ jRCTs041230120 ）註冊，並已關閉招募。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: Between Dec 26, 2023, and May 20, 2025, we randomly assigned 972 patients, of whom 970 (99%) constituted the intention-to-treat population after two were excluded because they were randomly assigned before site approval (486 [50%] to the 28-day treatment group, 292 [60%] men and 194 [40%] women]; and 484 [50%] to the 14-day treatment group, 264 [55%] men and 220 [45%] women). Median follow-up was 17·9 months (IQR 14·3-22·6). Median overall survival was 10·3 months (95% CI 9·5-11·6) in the 28-day group and 11·3 months (10·2-12·5) in the 14-day group (stratified hazard ratio 0·93 [95% CI 0·80-1·08]). The 12-month overall survival rates were 44·0% (95% CI 39·5-48·5) in the 28-day group and 47·5% (42·9-52·0) in the 14-day group. Neutropenia grade 3 or worse was reduced in the 14-day group (13% vs 39%; absolute difference 25 percentage points [95% CI 20-31]), as was anorexia grade 2 or worse (15% vs 26%; absolute difference 11 percentage points [6-16]). Two treatment-related deaths occurred in the 14-day group and none in the 28-day group.
abstract.textZh: 在2023年12月26日至2025年5月20日期間，我們隨機分配了972名患者，其中970名（ 99 ％ ）在兩名患者被排除後構成意向治療人羣，因為他們在研究中心批準前被隨機分配（ 486 [50 ％]至28天治療組， 292 [60 ％]名男性和194 [40 ％]名女性） ； 484 [50 ％]至14天治療組， 264 [55 ％]名男性和220 [45 ％]名女性）。 中位隨訪時間為17 · 9個月（ IQR 14 · 3-22 · 6 ）。 28天組的中位總生存期為10 · 3個月（ 95% CI 9 · 5-11 · 6 ） ， 14天組為11 · 3個月（ 10 · 2-12 · 5 ） （分層風險比0 · 93 [95% CI 0 · 80-1 · 08] ）。 28天組的12個月總生存率為44 · 0% (95% CI 39 · 5-48 · 5) ， 14天組為47 · 5% (42 · 9-52 · 0)。 14天組嗜中性白血球缺乏症3級或更低(13% vs 39% ；絕對差異25個百分點[95% CI 20-31]) ，厭食症2級或更低(15% vs 26% ；絕對差異11個百分點[6-16])。 14天組中發生2例與治療相關的死亡， 28天組中沒有發生任何死亡。

abstract.label: INTERPRETATION
abstract.text: A 14-day schedule of FTD-TPI plus bevacizumab was non-inferior to the conventional 28-day schedule for overall survival, while reducing haematological and gastrointestinal toxicity. These findings support this simplified schedule as the new standard for FTD-TPI plus bevacizumab in refractory metastatic colorectal cancer.
abstract.textZh: FTD-TPI加貝伐珠單抗的14天計劃總體生存期不劣於傳統的28天計劃，同時降低了血液學和胃腸道毒性。這些發現支持這種簡化的時間表，作為難治性轉移性大腸直腸癌的FTD-TPI加上貝伐單抗的新標準。

articles.title: Efficacy and safety of mitapivat in patients with sickle cell disease (RISE UP): a phase 3, double-blind, global, randomised, placebo-controlled trial
articles.authors: Andemariam B, Kuo KHM, Algahtani FH, Al Kindi S, Ataga KI, Bartolucci P, Campbell A, Colombatti R, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Persistent haemolytic anaemia and recurrent vaso-occlusion drive complications and accelerate mortality in sickle cell disease. Mitapivat, an oral allosteric activator of pyruvate kinase, increases ATP and decreases 2,3-DPG with the potential to improve haemolytic anaemia and reduce sickling. We aimed to evaluate the efficacy and safety of mitapivat in patients with sickle cell disease.
abstract.textZh: 持續溶血性貧血和復發性血管閉塞會導致鎌狀細胞疾病的併發症並加速死亡率。Mitapivat是丙酮酸激酶的口服變構激活劑，增加ATP並降低2,3-DPG ，具有改善溶血性貧血和減少鎌狀血的潛力。我們旨在評估mitapivat在鐮狀細胞病患者中的有效性和安全性。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: We report results from RISE UP, a phase 3, double-blind, global, randomised, placebo-controlled trial from 69 sites across 15 countries. Patients older than 16 years with anaemia and recurrent sickle cell pain crises were randomly assigned (2:1) to either mitapivat 100 mg or placebo twice a day using permuted-block randomisation. Primary endpoints, assessed in all randomly assigned patients, were haemoglobin response (≥1·0 g/dL increase in average haemoglobin concentration from week 24 to week 52 compared with baseline) and annualised rate of sickle cell pain crises. This study is registered with ClinicalTrials.gov, NCT05031780, and the open-label extension is ongoing.
abstract.textZh: 我們報告了RISE UP的結果，這是一項來自15個國家69個研究中心的3期、雙盲、全球、隨機、安慰劑對照試驗。16歲以上患有貧血和復發性鎌狀細胞疼痛危機的患者被隨機分配（ 2: 1 ）至mitapivat 100 mg或安慰劑，每天兩次，使用順序塊隨機分配。在所有隨機分配的患者中評估的主要終點是血紅蛋白反應（與基線相比，從第24週到第52週的平均血紅蛋白濃度增加≥ 1 · 0g/dL ）和鐮狀細胞疼痛危機的年化率。本研究已在ClinicalTrials.gov （ NCT05031780 ）註冊，開放標籤延伸正在進行中。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: A total of 207 patients were randomly assigned to mitapivat (138 [67%]) or placebo (69 [33%]). 56 (41%) of 138 patients in the mitapivat group had a haemoglobin response, compared with two (3%) of 69 patients on placebo (adjusted difference 38%, 95% CI 29-47; two-sided p<0·0001). The annualised rate (95% CI) of sickle cell pain crises was 2·6 (2·3-3·0) for mitapivat and 3·1 (2·6-3·6) for placebo (two-sided p=0·1213). Serious adverse events were reported in 28 (20%) patients on mitapivat and 20 (29%) patients on placebo; one (1%) patient and 0 patients, respectively, were deemed treatment related.
abstract.textZh: 總共有207名患者被隨機分配到mitapivat （ 138 [67%] ）或安慰劑（ 69 [33%] ）。mitapivat組138名患者中有56名（ 41% ）有血紅蛋白反應，而安慰劑組69名患者中有2名（ 3% ）有血紅蛋白反應（調整後差異38% ， 95% CI 29-47 ；雙側p < 0.0001 ）。mitapivat的鐮狀細胞疼痛危機年化率(95% CI)為2 · 6 (2 · 3-3 · 0) ，安慰劑為3 · 1 (2 · 6-3 · 6) (雙側p = 0 · 1213)。在28名(20%) mitapivat患者和20名(29%)安慰劑患者中報告了嚴重不良事件；分別有1名(1%)患者和0名患者被認為與治療相關。

abstract.label: INTERPRETATION
abstract.text: Mitapivat, an oral pyruvate kinase activator, with a novel mechanism that ameliorates haemolytic anaemia, has the potential to be an effective and convenient disease-modifying treatment for people with sickle cell disease.
abstract.textZh: Mitapivat是一種口服丙酮酸激酶激活劑，具有改善溶血性貧血的新機制，有可能成為鐮狀細胞病患者有效且方便的疾病修飾治療方法。

articles.title: Conversational diagnostic artificial intelligence in ambulatory primary care: a prospective feasibility study
articles.authors: Brodeur PG, Koshy JM, Palepu A, Saab K, Homiar A, Ruparel R, Wu C, Tanno R, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Artificial intelligence (AI)-based systems show promise for assisting primary care providers (PCPs) with patient care. We aimed to evaluate the safety and quality of clinical conversations of a patient-facing conversational AI system, which engaged in real-world urgent primary care appointments.
abstract.textZh: 基於人工智能（ AI ）的系統有望協助初級保健提供者（ PCP ）進行患者護理。我們的目標是評估面向患者的對話式AI系統的臨牀對話的安全性和質量，該系統從事現實世界的緊急初級保健預約。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In this prospective, single-centre, single-arm feasibility study, English-speaking patients aged at least 18 years interacted with the Articulate Medical Intelligence Explorer (AMIE) up to 5 days before a single-complaint urgent primary care appointment. Physician safety supervisors monitored all interactions and were trained to intervene on the basis of predefined safety criteria. AMIE transcripts and summaries were shared with PCPs before the visit. Primary outcomes were the number of supervised conversation safety stops, AMIE's conversation quality assessed by clinical evaluators, and patient and PCP experiences per surveys. This study is registered with ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT06911398).
abstract.textZh: 在這項前瞻性、單中心、單臂可行性研究中，年滿18歲的英語患者在單一投訴緊急初級保健預約前最多5天與Articulate Medical Intelligence Explorer （ AMIE ）進行互動。醫生安全主管監測所有互動，並接受培訓，根據預先定義的安全標準進行幹預。造訪前已與PCP分享AMIE成績單和摘要。主要結果是監督對話安全停止的次數、臨牀評估人員評估的AMIE對話質量，以及每次調查的患者和PCP經驗。本研究已在ClinicalTrials.gov （ NCT06911398 ）注冊。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: From April to November, 2025, 114 patients were enrolled with 98 completing both the AMIE interaction and the PCP appointment. Zero conversation safety stops were required on the basis of prespecified criteria. Safety supervisors noted one hallucination and added clinical information in five interactions. AMIE's conversations were rated favourably in 87-100% of cases (17 criteria) by clinical evaluators, and 48-96% (16 criteria) by patients. Patient attitudes towards AI improved after interacting with AMIE and remained elevated after the patient's visit with their physician. PCPs completed post-surveys in 60 of 98 cases, including 44 cases in which they reviewed the AMIE transcript before the visit. PCPs found AMIE helpful for visit preparation in 33 of 44 cases and reported that it might have changed their behaviour in 25 of 44 cases.
abstract.textZh: 從2025年4月到11月，共招募了114名患者，其中98名患者完成了AMIE互動和PCP預約。根據預先指定的標準，要求零通話安全停止。安全主管注意到一種幻覺，並在五次互動中添加了臨牀信息。臨牀評估人員對AMIE的對話評分為87-100% (17項標準) ，對患者評分為48-96% (16項標準)。與AMIE互動後，患者對AI的態度有所改善，並在患者與醫生就診後保持升高。PCP在98例病例中完成了60例的調查後調查，其中包括44例他們在訪問前審查了AMIE成績單的病例。PCP發現AMIE在44例中的33例中對就診準備有幫助，並報告說在44例中的25例中可能改變了他們的行為。

abstract.label: INTERPRETATION
abstract.text: Although further research is needed, this study shows the initial feasibility of conversational AI in a real-world setting-assessed via conversation safety and quality, as well as user acceptance-and represents a crucial step towards clinical translation.
abstract.textZh: 雖然還需要進一步的研究，但這項研究顯示了會話式人工智慧在真實環境中的初步可行性--通過對話安全性和質量以及用戶接受度進行評估--並代表了臨牀翻譯的關鍵一步。

articles.title: Oral deucrictibant for on-demand treatment of hereditary angioedema attacks: a phase 3, multicentre, randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled crossover trial
articles.authors: Riedl MA, Li PH, Adatia A, Cancian M, Stobiecki M, Valerieva A, Grumach AS, Lumry WR, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: In hereditary angioedema, a rare bradykinin-mediated condition, oral on-demand treatments facilitating prompt administration and providing rapid, sustained relief and attack resolution remain scant. We investigated the efficacy and safety of deucrictibant, an oral bradykinin B2 receptor antagonist, for on-demand treatment of hereditary angioedema attacks.
abstract.textZh: 在遺傳性血管性水腫（一種罕見的緩激肽介導的疾病）中，口服按需治療促進迅速給藥並提供快速，持續的緩解和攻擊解決仍然很少。我們研究了deucrictibant （一種口服緩激肽B2受體拮抗劑）用於按需治療遺傳性血管性水腫發作的有效性和安全性。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: RAPIDe-3 was a phase 3, double-blind, 2 × 2 crossover trial in adolescent and adult participants (aged ≥12 to <18 years and aged ≥18 to ≤75 years, respectively) with hereditary angioedema, at 59 sites across 24 countries on six continents. Eligible participants had hereditary angioedema, including those with normal C1 inhibitor associated with a documented genetic variant, at least two attacks within the last 3 months before screening, and experience with effectively using conventional on-demand therapies for hereditary angioedema attacks. Participants were randomly allocated in a 1:1 ratio to one of two double-blind crossover sequences to treat two attacks with a 20 mg oral deucrictibant immediate-release capsule or placebo as either deucrictibant-placebo or placebo-deucrictibant, stratified by age and use of long-term prophylaxis. The primary endpoint was time to onset of symptom relief, defined as Patient Global Impression of Change rating of at least a little better. Safety was assessed in all participants who received any dose of study drug. RAPIDe-3 is registered with ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT06343779) and is complete.
abstract.textZh: RAPIDe-3是一項3期、雙盲、2 × 2交叉試驗，針對青少年和成人參與者（分別年齡≥ 12至< 18歲和年齡≥ 18至≤ 75歲）的遺傳性血管性水腫，在六大洲24個國家的59個研究中心進行。 符合資格的參與者患有遺傳性血管性水腫，包括那些具有與記錄的遺傳變異相關的正常C1抑制劑的參與者，在篩選前的過去3個月內至少有兩次發作，並且具有有效使用傳統按需治療遺傳性血管性水腫發作的經驗。 將參與者以1: 1的比例隨機分配到兩個雙盲交叉序列中的一個，以治療兩次發作，使用20 mg口服減速劑即時釋放膠囊或安慰劑作為減速劑-安慰劑或安慰劑-減速劑，按年齡和使用長期預防分層。 主要終點是症狀緩解開始的時間，定義為患者對變化的整體印象評分至少好一點。 在接受任何劑量研究藥物的所有參與者中評估安全性。 RAPIDe-3已在ClinicalTrials.gov （ NCT06343779 ）注冊並已完成。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: Between April 4, 2024, and Sept 1, 2025, 149 people were assessed for eligibility, and 134 eligible participants (ten [7%] adolescents and 124 [93%] adults) were randomly allocated. 58 (43%) were male and 76 (57%) were female, and the median age was 38·0 years (IQR 27·0-50·0). 113 participants treated 201 attacks. The primary efficacy analysis included 88 participants with paired treated attacks. Of these, 47 (53%) participants were female and 41 (47%) were male, and 60 (68%), 16 (18%), 4 (5%), and 1 (1%) were White, Asian, Black, and American Indian or Alaska Native, respectively. Onset of symptom relief occurred significantly faster with deucrictibant than placebo, with median times of 1·28 h (95% CI 1·05 to 1·52) and more than 12 h (5·82 to >12), respectively (p<0·0001). Fatigue was the only adverse event reported more than once within 3 days post-treatment: a single event was reported by two participants, one of which was deemed unrelated to treatment. Across the study, no treatment-related adverse events were assessed as severe or serious, and no adverse events led to treatment discontinuation.
abstract.textZh: 在2024年4月4日至2025年9月1日期間，對149人進行了資格評估，並隨機分配了134名符合資格的參與者（ 10名[7%]青少年和124名[93%]成人）。58名（ 43% ）為男性， 76名（ 57% ）為女性，中位年齡為38 · 0歲（ IQR 27 · 0-50 · 0 ）。113名參與者治療了201次發作。 主要療效分析包括88名配對治療發作的參與者。 其中， 47名（ 53 ％ ）參與者為女性， 41名（ 47 ％ ）為男性， 60名（ 68 ％ ）、16名（ 18 ％ ）、4名（ 5 ％ ）和1名（ 1 ％ ）分別為白人、亞裔、黑人和美洲印第安人或阿拉斯加原住民。 Deucrictibant的症狀緩解發生明顯快於安慰劑，中位時間分別為1 · 28小時(95% CI 1 · 05至1 · 52)和超過12小時(5 · 82至> 12) (p < 0 · 0001)。 疲勞是治療後3天內多次報告的唯一不良事件：兩名參與者報告了單一事件，其中一例被認為與治療無關。 在整個研究中，沒有任何治療相關不良事件被評估為嚴重或嚴重，也沒有任何不良事件導致治療停止。

abstract.label: INTERPRETATION
abstract.text: Oral deucrictibant provided faster times to symptom relief than placebo and was generally well tolerated. These results support the use of deucrictibant as potentially the first orally administered bradykinin B2 receptor antagonist for the treatment of attacks of bradykinin-mediated angioedema, including hereditary angioedema, and may address an unmet need for options that are effective and well tolerated, with convenient administration.
abstract.textZh: 口服deucrictibant比安慰劑更快地緩解症狀，並且通常具有良好的耐受性。這些結果支持使用減速劑作為第一種口服施用的緩激肽B2受體拮抗劑，用於治療緩激肽介導的血管性水腫（包括遺傳性血管性水腫）的發作，並且可以解決對有效且耐受性良好的選擇的未滿足的需求，並且給予方便。

articles.title: The public health challenges of children's and adolescents' digital media use: applying the digital determinants of health as an interpretive framework
articles.authors: Holly L, Raeside R, Morton A, Shi J, Padmapriya N, Müller-Riemenschneider F, Digital Determinants of Health Youth Advisory Group

abstract.text: Children and adolescents are growing up in a hybrid world in which digital media has become part of the infrastructure of everyday life and a structural determinant of their health. In the second paper of this Series on the digital determinants of health, we apply the framework introduced in the first paper to one of the most contested questions in public health: how young people's digital media use shapes their health and wellbeing. Using the digital determinants of health framework to interpret the current evidence base, we examine what is known, and what remains poorly understood, about the public health implications of children's and adolescents' digital media use. Evidence suggests that digital media use can be associated with both benefits and harms although it is more consistently associated with adverse mental, behavioural, physical, cognitive, and social outcomes, with developmental stage emerging as an important moderator. Illustrative modelling indicates the potential population burden is substantial, even as its causal basis remains uncertain. Research to date has privileged easily measured proxies, such as screen time, and given insufficient attention to the platform design, algorithmic systems, and commercial incentives that shape young people's experiences. Situating young people's digital media use with a digital determinants of health framework, we conclude that protecting children's and adolescents' health calls for a precautionary, structural response-one that moves beyond individual behaviour change to reshape the digital systems, incentives, and knowledge practices that determine how digital media affects health.

articles.title: Governing the digital determinants of health for children and young people: a global public health imperative
articles.authors: Prainsack B, Medhora RP, Kickbusch I

abstract.text: The digital determinants of health are the structural conditions through which digital infrastructures, business models, and design choices shape health outcomes. Yet these determinants remain largely outside public health policy and remain fragmented across regulatory sectors. Rather than regulating individual technologies in isolation, governance should ensure that digital systems and environments advance population health and reduce inequities. A public health approach shifts attention from individual responsibility-and the tendency to blame users-towards the governance of the structural features that produce health risks and inequities. We identify four governance domains for the digital determinants of health: infrastructure and access, platform design and commercial practices, data governance and surveillance, and institutional accountability and rights. Effectively governing these domains requires intersectoral strategies that tackle problematic concentrations of political and economic power. We argue that the governance of the digital determinants of health should be recognised as a core public health function, with the health of children and young people as a priority and entry point and precaution as a guiding governance principle.
abstract.textZh: 健康的數位決定因素是數位基礎設施、商業模式和設計選擇塑造健康結果的結構條件。 然而，這些決定因素在很大程度上仍然在公共衛生政策之外，並且在各個監管部門中仍然是分散的。 治理應確保數位系統和環境促進人口健康並減少不平等，而不是孤立地監管個別技術。 公共衛生方法將注意力從個人責任（以及將責任歸咎於用戶的傾向）轉向對產生健康風險和不公平的結構特徵的治理。 我們為健康的數位決定因素確定了四個治理領域：基礎設施和存取、平臺設計和商業實踐、數據治理和監控，以及機構責任和權利。 有效治理這些領域需要跨部門戰略來解決政治和經濟權力集中的問題。 我們認為，應將數位健康決定因素的治理視為核心公共衛生功能，以兒童和青少年的健康為優先，以切入點和預防措施為指導治理原則。

articles.title: The digital determinants of health: a new era for global public health
articles.authors: Shaw J, Gross N, Saldaña-Tejeda A, Atuire C, Prainsack B, Holly L, Kickbusch I

abstract.text: Digital transformations exert increasing influence over the lives of the global population, shaping opportunities and generating harms for health and wellbeing across the spectrum of digital access and engagement. The scale of influence of digital transformations on human and planetary health marks the urgency of attention to the digital determinants of health (DDoH). In this Series paper, we describe a prevailing digital sociotechnological order (DSTO) as the structural source of the DDoH. The DSTO is composed of a set of dominant assumptions that motivate digital practices operating through four features (political norms, economic logics, infrastructures, and personal and social practices) to affect human and planetary health. We describe the implications of the DSTO for understanding, studying, and governing the DDoH, and present recommendations for future work.
abstract.textZh: 數位轉型對全球人口的生活產生越來越大的影響，在數位存取和參與的範圍內塑造機會並對健康和福祉產生危害。數位轉型對人類和地球健康的影響規模，標誌著迫切需要關注健康的數位決定因素(DDoH)。在本系列論文中，我們描述了流行的數字社會技術秩序（ DSTO ）作為DDoH的結構來源。DSTO由一組主要假設組成，這些假設通過四種特徵（政治規範、經濟邏輯、基礎設施以及個人和社會實踐）來激勵數字實踐，以影響人類和地球健康。我們描述了DSTO對理解、研究和管理DDoH的影響，並為未來的工作提出建議。

articles.title: Sodium-Glucose Cotransporter 2 Inhibitor Use and Levels of Hemoglobin, Markers of Iron Metabolism, and Erythropoiesis: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Clinical Trials
articles.authors: Yang Y, Yang C, Wang Y, Rawee P, Cases A, Leaf DE, Del Vecchio L, Muka T, et al.

abstract.label: IMPORTANCE
abstract.text: In randomized clinical trials, sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 (SGLT2) inhibitor use was associated with increased hemoglobin and hematocrit compared with placebo. However, the magnitude and importance of this association remain unclear.
abstract.textZh: 在隨機臨牀試驗中，與安慰劑相比，使用鈉葡萄糖共轉運蛋白2 （ SGLT2 ）抑制劑與血紅蛋白和紅細胞比容增加有關。然而，這種關聯的規模和重要性仍然不清楚。

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To evaluate the associations between SGLT2 inhibitor use and levels of hemoglobin, hematocrit, and markers of iron metabolism and erythropoiesis compared with placebo or active comparator.
abstract.textZh: 與安慰劑或活性比較劑相比，評估SGLT2抑制劑的使用與血紅蛋白、紅細胞比容、鐵代謝和紅細胞生成標誌物水平之間的關聯。

abstract.label: DATA SOURCES
abstract.text: PubMed, Web of Science, and the Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials (CENTRAL) were searched from inception to July 22, 2026.
abstract.textZh: 從開始到2026年7月22日， PubMed、Web of Science和Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials (CENTRAL)被搜索。

abstract.label: STUDY SELECTION
abstract.text: Randomized, double-masked clinical trials comparing SGLT2 inhibitor use with placebo or active comparators in patients with 1 or more of the following conditions: cardiovascular disease, diabetes, heart failure, and chronic kidney disease.
abstract.textZh: 在患有心血管疾病、糖尿病、心力衰竭和慢性腎臟疾病的患者中比較SGLT2抑制劑與安慰劑或活性比較劑的隨機雙掩蔽臨牀試驗。

abstract.label: DATA EXTRACTION AND SYNTHESIS
abstract.text: Three reviewers independently extracted data and results were pooled using random-effects meta-analysis.
abstract.textZh: 三位審查者使用隨機效應薈萃分析獨立提取資料和結果。

abstract.label: MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES
abstract.text: Primary outcomes were changes in hemoglobin and hematocrit. Secondary outcomes were changes in red blood cell concentration, erythropoietin (EPO), and iron measures (serum iron, ferritin, transferrin saturation, and hepcidin).
abstract.textZh: 主要結果是血紅蛋白和血細胞比容的變化。次要結果是紅細胞濃度、促紅細胞生成素（ EPO ）和鐵測量（血清鐵、鐵蛋白、轉鐵蛋白飽和度和hepcidin ）的變化。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: A total of 85 randomized clinical trials were analyzed (median [IQR] duration, 24 [12-32] weeks), including 70 543 participants (mean [SD] age, 62.4 [9.4] years; 25 334 female [35.9%]). Mean (SD) baseline hemoglobin was 13.6 (1.5) g/dL; baseline hematocrit was 41.5% (4.9). Seventy-eight clinical trials (67 208 participants) compared SGLT2 inhibitors with placebo, and 7 clinical trials (3335 participants) used active comparators, most commonly sitagliptin (2 trials [1158 participants]). From baseline to follow-up, hemoglobin changed by 0.55 g/dL (95% CI, 0.49 to 0.61 g/dL; P < .001) in the SGLT2 inhibitor group, and -0.08 g/dL (95% CI, -0.13 to -0.03 g/dL; P = .003) in the control group (difference, 0.60 g/dL; 95% CI, 0.55 to 0.66 g/dL; P < .001). From baseline to follow-up, hematocrit changed by 2.17% (95% CI, 1.95% to 2.39%; P < .001) in the SGLT2 inhibitor group and -0.13% (95% CI, -0.28% to 0.01%; P = .07) in the control group (difference, 2.36%; 95% CI, 2.19% to 2.52%; P < .001). Of the 6 secondary outcomes, 4 showed significant associations with SGLT2 inhibitors, including increased EPO (2.35 mIU/mL in SGLT2 inhibitor group vs 0.04 mIU/mL in control group; difference, 2.11 mIU/mL [95% CI, 0.5-3.71 mIU/mL]; P = .01) and decreased transferrin saturation (-2.2% in SGLT2 inhibitor group vs -0.10% in control group; difference, -0.84% [95% CI, -1.21% to -0.47%]; P < .001).
abstract.textZh: 總共分析了85項隨機臨牀試驗（中位[IQR]持續時間， 24 [12-32]週） ，其中包括70 543名參與者（平均[SD]年齡， 62.4 [9.4]歲； 25 334名女性[35.9%] ）。 平均(SD)基線血紅蛋白為13.6 (1.5) g/dL ；基線紅細胞比容為41.5% (4.9)。 78項臨牀試驗（ 67 208名參與者）將SGLT2抑制劑與安慰劑進行比較， 7項臨牀試驗（ 3335名參與者）使用活性比較物，最常見的是西格列汀（ 2項試驗[1158名參與者] ）。 從基線到隨訪， SGLT2抑制劑組的血紅蛋白變化為0.55 g/dL (95% CI ， 0.49至0.61 g/dL ； P < 0.001) ，對照組為-0.08 g/dL (95% CI ， -0.13至-0.03 g/dL ； P = 0.003) (差異為0.60 g/dL ； 95% CI ， 0.55至0.66 g/dL ； P < 0.001)。 從基線到隨訪， SGLT2抑制劑組的紅細胞比容變化為2.17% (95% CI ， 1.95%至2.39% ； P < 0.001) ，對照組變化為-0.13% (95% CI ， -0.28%至0.01% ； P = 0.07) (差異， 2.36% ； 95% CI ， 2.19%至2.52% ； P < 0.001)。 在6個次要結果中， 4個顯示出與SGLT2抑制劑的顯著相關性，包括EPO增加（ SGLT2抑制劑組為2.35 mIU/mL ，對照組為0.04 mIU/mL ；差異為2.11 mIU/mL [95% CI ， 0.5-3.71 mIU/mL] ； P = 0.01 ）和轉鐵蛋白飽和度降低（ SGLT2抑制劑組為-2.2% ，對照組為-0.10% ；差異為-0.84% [95% CI ， -1.21%至-0.47%] ； P < 0.001 ）。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE
abstract.text: In a meta-analysis of randomized clinical trials, compared with control, SGLT2 inhibitor use was associated with small statistically significant increases in hemoglobin and hematocrit levels. The clinical significance of these findings is unclear.
abstract.textZh: 在一項隨機臨牀試驗的薈萃分析中，與對照相比， SGLT2抑制劑的使用與血紅蛋白和紅細胞比容水平的小幅統計顯著增加有關。這些發現的臨牀意義尚不清楚。

articles.title: Ravulizumab in IgA Nephropathy - Interim Analysis of a Phase 3 Trial
articles.authors: Barratt J, Farag YMK, Rice K, Cammett TJ, Inker LA, Trimarchi H, Bruchfeld A, Heerspink HJL, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: In patients with IgA nephropathy, complement activation drives glomerular inflammation, which leads to hematuria, proteinuria, and nephron loss. Ravulizumab is a terminal complement inhibitor that prevents formation of C5a and C5b-9.
abstract.textZh: 在IgA腎病患者中，補體活化會推動腎小球發炎，導致血尿、蛋白尿和腎元喪失。Ravulizumab是一種末端補體抑制劑，可防止C5a和C5b-9的形成。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In this phase 3 trial, we enrolled adults with IgA nephropathy who had an estimated glomerular filtration rate of at least 30 ml per minute per 1.73 m2 of body-surface area and proteinuria (24-hour urinary protein-to-creatinine ratio [with protein and creatinine both measured in grams] of ≥0.75 or total urinary protein excretion of ≥1.0 g per day), despite standard therapy. Patients were randomly assigned in a 1:1 ratio to receive an intravenous infusion of either ravulizumab or placebo every 8 weeks. In the prespecified interim analysis, the primary efficacy end point was the change from baseline in the 24-hour urinary protein-to-creatinine ratio at week 34. Safety was also assessed.
abstract.textZh: 在這項3期試驗中，我們招募了患有IgA腎病的成人，他們的估計腎小球濾過率至少為每分鐘30毫升/每1.73平方公尺的身體表面積和蛋白尿（ 24小時尿蛋白與肌酸酐比率[蛋白質和肌酸酐均以克為單位測量] ≥ 0.75或總尿蛋白排泄量≥每天1.0克） ，儘管有標準治療。患者以1: 1的比例隨機分配，每8週接受一次ravulizumab或安慰劑的靜脈輸注。在預先指定的中期分析中，主要療效終點是第34週24小時尿蛋白與肌酸酐比率相較於基線的變化。也評估了安全性。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: In all, 485 patients underwent randomization, with 240 patients assigned to the ravulizumab group and 245 to the placebo group; 352 patients (176 in each group) were included in the interim analysis. In the ravulizumab group, the geometric mean 24-hour urinary protein-to-creatinine ratio at baseline and at week 34 was 1.56 and 0.83, respectively; in the placebo group, it was 1.60 and 1.48, respectively. At week 34, a significant reduction in the geometric mean 24-hour urinary protein-to-creatinine ratio was observed with ravulizumab (-46.6%) as compared with the reduction observed with placebo (-5.6%), corresponding to an adjusted geometric mean 24-hour urinary protein-to-creatinine ratio that was 43.4% (99% confidence interval, 30.1 to 54.2) lower with ravulizumab than with placebo (P<0.001). Adverse events occurred in 69.5% of the patients receiving ravulizumab and in 75.8% of those receiving placebo; serious adverse events occurred in 4.6% and 9.0%, respectively. No meningococcal infections or deaths occurred.
abstract.textZh: 總共有485名患者接受隨機分組，其中240名患者被分配到ravulizumab組， 245名患者被分配到安慰劑組； 352名患者（每組176名）被納入期中分析。 在ravulizumab組中，基線和第34週時的幾何平均24小時尿蛋白與肌酸酐比率分別為1.56和0.83 ；在安慰劑組中，該比率分別為1.60和1.48。 在第34週，與安慰劑相比， ravulizumab的幾何平均24小時尿蛋白與肌酸酐比率顯著降低（ -46.6% ） ，對應於調整的幾何平均24小時尿蛋白與肌酸酐比率， ravulizumab的幾何平均24小時尿蛋白與肌酸酐比率比安慰劑低43.4% （ 99%置信區間， 30.1至54.2 ） （ P < 0.001 ）。 接受ravulizumab的患者中有69.5%發生不良事件，接受安慰劑的患者中有75.8%發生不良事件；嚴重不良事件發生率分別為4.6%和9.0%。 未發生腦膜炎球菌感染或死亡。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: In adults with IgA nephropathy, ravulizumab resulted in a significantly greater reduction in the protein-to-creatinine ratio than placebo at week 34. (Funded by Alexion, AstraZeneca Rare Disease Unit; I CAN ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT06291376; EU Clinical Trials number, 2023-507851-31-00.).
abstract.textZh: 在患有IgA腎病的成人中，與安慰劑相比，在第34週時， ravulizumab導致蛋白與肌酸酐比率顯著降低。（由Alexion資助，阿斯利康罕見疾病部門； I CAN ClinicalTrials.gov編號， NCT06291376 ；歐盟臨牀試驗編號， 2023-507851-31-00。）

articles.title: Interim Analysis of a Phase 3 Trial of Povetacicept in IgA Nephropathy
articles.authors: Barratt J, Zhang H, Han SH, Suzuki Y, Tumlin J, Chacko B, Noronha IL, Madan A, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: B-cell activating factor (BAFF) and a proliferation-inducing ligand (APRIL) have distinct roles in IgA-producing B-cell populations and appear to be central to the pathogenesis of IgA nephropathy. Povetacicept, an enhanced, variant transmembrane activator and calcium-modulator and cyclophilin-ligand interactor (TACI)-Fc fragment fusion therapeutic, is engineered for dual inhibition of BAFF and APRIL.
abstract.textZh: B細胞活化因子（ BAFF ）和增殖誘導配體（ APRIL ）在產生IgA的B細胞羣中具有不同的作用，並且似乎是IgA腎病發病機制的核心。Povetacicept是一種增強型跨膜活化劑和鈣調節劑以及親環素配體相互作用物（ TACI ） -Fc片段融合治療劑，專為雙重抑制BAFF和APRIL而設計。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In this ongoing, phase 3, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial, participants with biopsy-proven IgA nephropathy receiving stable background therapy were randomly assigned in a 2:1 ratio to receive povetacicept at a dose of 80 mg or placebo subcutaneously every 4 weeks. The primary end point of this prespecified interim analysis was the change in the 24-hour urinary protein-to-creatinine ratio at week 36. Secondary end points were the change at week 36 in galactose-deficient IgA1 levels and hematuria resolution at week 36 among participants with baseline hematuria.
abstract.textZh: 在這項正在進行的3期、雙盲、安慰劑對照試驗中，接受穩定背景治療的經活組織檢查證實的IgA腎病參與者以2: 1的比例被隨機分配接受80毫克劑量的povetacicept或每4週一次的安慰劑皮下治療。這項預先規定的期中分析的主要終點是第36週24小時尿蛋白與肌酸酐比率的變化。次要終點是基線期血尿參與者中第36週半乳糖缺乏IgA1水平的變化和第36週血尿消退。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: A total of 557 participants received povetacicept (372 participants) or placebo (185 participants). Efficacy analyses included the first 199 participants who had undergone randomization (131 in the povetacicept group and 68 in the placebo group). The 24-hour urinary protein-to-creatinine ratio decreased by 52.0% with povetacicept and by 4.3% with placebo by week 36 (adjusted difference, -49.8 percentage points; 95% confidence interval [CI], -58.6 to -39.2; P<0.001). Galactose-deficient IgA1 levels decreased by 77.4% with povetacicept and increased by 9.1% with placebo (adjusted difference, -79.3 percentage points; 95% CI, -82.2 to -75.9; P<0.001). Among the participants with baseline hematuria, resolution occurred in 85% with povetacicept and in 23% with placebo (adjusted difference, 62 percentage points; 95% CI, 45 to 78; P<0.001). The incidence of adverse events (75% with povetacicept and 78% with placebo) and serious adverse events (3% and 4%, respectively) were similar in the trial groups.
abstract.textZh: 共有557名參與者接受povetacicept （ 372名參與者）或安慰劑（ 185名參與者）。 療效分析包括首199名經過隨機分組的參與者（ povetacicept組131名和安慰劑組68名）。 到第36週， 24小時尿蛋白與肌酸酐比率在povetacicept組下降了52.0% ，在安慰劑組下降了4.3% （調整後的差異， -49.8個百分點； 95%置信區間[CI] ， -58.6至-39.2 ； P < 0.001 ）。 半乳糖缺乏的IgA1水平在povetacicept中下降了77.4% ，在安慰劑中增加了9.1% （調整後的差異， -79.3個百分點； 95% CI ， -82.2至-75.9 ； P < 0.001 ）。 在基線期血尿的參與者中， povetacicept的解決率為85% ，安慰劑的解決率為23% （調整差異， 62個百分點； 95% CI ， 45至78 ； P < 0.001 ）。 試驗組中不良事件的發生率（ povetacicept為75% ，安慰劑為78% ）和嚴重不良事件的發生率（分別為3%和4% ）相似。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: Povetacicept led to a significantly greater reduction in the 24-hour urinary protein-to-creatinine ratio than placebo by week 36 in participants with IgA nephropathy. (Funded by Vertex Pharmaceuticals; RAINIER AIS-D08 ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT06564142.).

articles.title: Trastuzumab Rezetecan in ERBB2-Low Advanced Breast Cancer: The HORIZON-Breast06 Randomized Clinical Trial
articles.authors: Fan Y, Liu Y, Wang Y, Ouyang Q, Zhang Q, Cui J, Li J, Ding Q, et al.

abstract.label: IMPORTANCE
abstract.text: Trastuzumab rezetecan (SHR-A1811) has demonstrated encouraging antitumor activity in a global phase 1 trial involving heavily pretreated patients with erythroblastic oncogene B (ERBB2)-low metastatic breast cancer.
abstract.textZh: 曲妥珠單抗rezetecan (SHR-A1811)已在一項全球1期試驗中證明具有令人鼓舞的抗腫瘤活性，該試驗涉及大量預先治療的紅細胞癌基因B (ERBB2)低轉移性乳腺癌患者。

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To compare trastuzumab rezetecan vs physician's choice of chemotherapy in patients with ERBB2-low metastatic breast cancer.
abstract.textZh: 比較曲妥珠單抗Rezetecan與醫生在ERBB2低轉移性乳腺癌患者中選擇的化療。

abstract.label: DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS
abstract.text: This open-label, randomized, multicenter phase 3 trial was conducted at 73 hospitals across China. Eligible patients were females aged 18 to 75 years with centrally confirmed ERBB2-low (immunohistochemistry [IHC] 1+ or IHC 2+/in-situ hybridization [ISH]-negative) unresectable locally recurrent or metastatic breast cancer who had received 1 or fewer prior lines of chemotherapy for metastatic disease, with prior endocrine therapy required for hormone receptor-positive disease. Enrollment began on June 30, 2023, and ended on August 20, 2025. The last day of follow-up for the final analysis for progression-free survival in the current study was March 20, 2026.
abstract.textZh: 這項開放標籤、隨機、多中心3期試驗在中國73家醫院進行。符合資格的患者是年齡在18至75歲之間、中央確診ERBB2低（免疫組織化學[IHC] 1 +或IHC 2 +/原位雜交[ISH]陰性）、不可切除的局部復發性或轉移性乳腺癌的女性，她們之前接受過1次或更少的轉移性疾病化療，且激素受體陽性疾病需要先前的內分泌治療。註冊於2023年6月30日開始，並於2025年8月20日結束。目前研究中無惡化存活期最終分析的最後追蹤日為2026年3月20日。

abstract.label: INTERVENTIONS
abstract.text: Patients were randomly assigned (1:1) to receive trastuzumab rezetecan (6.4 mg/kg intravenously every 3 weeks; n = 277) or physician's choice of chemotherapy (n = 274).
abstract.textZh: 患者被隨機分配（ 1: 1 ）接受曲妥珠單抗Rezetecan （每3週靜脈注射6.4 mg/kg ； n = 277 ）或醫生選擇化療（ n = 274 ）。

abstract.label: MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES
abstract.text: The primary end point was progression-free survival assessed by blinded independent central review in chemotherapy-naive patients and the overall population.
abstract.textZh: 主要終點是在初治化療患者和整體族羣中通過盲法獨立中央審查評估的無惡化生存期。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Between June 30, 2023, and August 20, 2025, a total of 551 patients were randomized, with a mean (SD) age of 54.9 (9.9) years. At the data cutoff (March 20, 2026), trastuzumab rezetecan significantly prolonged progression-free survival compared with chemotherapy in the chemotherapy-naive patients (median, 16.6 [95% CI, 14.0-19.4] months vs 6.8 [95% CI, 5.7-7.0] months; hazard ratio, 0.25 [95% CI, 0.19-0.33]; P < .001) and the overall population (median, 16.4 [95% CI, 14.0-16.8] months vs 6.8 [95% CI, 5.7-6.9] months; hazard ratio, 0.27 [95% CI, 0.21-0.34]; P < .001). The benefit was consistent in hormone receptor-negative disease (median progression-free survival: 16.5 vs 6.8 months; hazard ratio, 0.34, [95% CI, 0.22-0.54]) and hormone receptor-positive disease (median progression-free survival: 16.4 vs 6.7 months; hazard ratio, 0.24 [95% CI, 0.18-0.33]). Grade 3 or greater treatment-related adverse events occurred in 84.1% of patients (232/276) with trastuzumab rezetecan and 67.9% (184/271) with chemotherapy, most commonly decreased neutrophil count (180 [65.2%] vs 147 [54.2%]).
abstract.textZh: 在2023年6月30日至2025年8月20日期間，共有551名患者被隨機分組，平均(SD)年齡為54.9 (9.9)歲。 在數據截止時（ 2026年3月20日） ，與化療初治患者相比，曲妥珠單抗rezetecan顯著延長了無惡化生存期（中位數， 16.6 [95% CI ， 14.0-19.4]個月vs 6.8 [95% CI ， 5.7-7.0]個月；風險比， 0.25 [95% CI ， 0.19-0.33] ； P < 0.001 ）和總族羣（中位數， 16.4 [95% CI ， 14.0-16.8]個月vs 6.8 [95% CI ， 5.7-6.9]個月；風險比， 0.27 [95% CI ， 0.21-0.34] ； P < 0.001 ）。 激素受體陰性疾病（中位無惡化生存期： 16.5 vs 6.8個月；風險比率， 0.34 ， [95% CI ， 0.22-0.54] ）和激素受體陽性疾病（中位無惡化生存期： 16.4 vs 6.7個月；風險比率， 0.24 [95% CI ， 0.18-0.33] ）的受益是一致的。 3級或以上治療相關不良事件發生在84.1% （ 232/276 ）的曲妥珠單抗Rezetecan患者和67.9% （ 184/271 ）的化療患者，最常見的是中性白血球計數降低（ 180 [65.2%]對147 [54.2%] ）。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE
abstract.text: Trastuzumab rezetecan provided significant progression-free survival benefit over physician's choice of chemotherapy in patients with ERBB2-low advanced breast cancer, with benefit observed across all key subgroups. It exhibited the potential as a new treatment option with a distinct safety profile in this setting.
abstract.textZh: 曲妥珠單抗Rezetecan在ERBB2低度晚期乳腺癌患者中與醫生選擇化療相比，提供了顯著的無惡化生存期受益，在所有關鍵次組中均觀察到受益。它表現出作為一種新的治療選擇的潛力，在這種情況下具有獨特的安全性。

articles.title: Sibeprenlimab in IgA Nephropathy - Final Phase 3 Trial Analysis
articles.authors: Rizk DV, Barratt J, Suzuki Y, Zhang H, Wong MG, Liew A, Lafayette R, Tesař V, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Sibeprenlimab, a humanized monoclonal antibody, selectively inhibits the cytokine A proliferation-inducing ligand (APRIL), a key driver of IgA nephropathy. Preliminary trial results with regard to the primary end point of the 24-hour urinary protein-to-creatinine ratio at 9 months after treatment as compared with baseline have been reported, but secondary end points, including outcomes regarding estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR), have not.
abstract.textZh: Sibeprenlimab是一種人源化單株抗體，選擇性地抑制細胞因子A增殖誘導配體（ APRIL ） ，這是IgA腎病的關鍵驅動因素。與基線相比，已報告治療後9個月24小時尿蛋白與肌酸酐比率的主要終點的初步試驗結果，但次要終點，包括有關估計腎小球濾過率（ eGFR ）的結果，尚未報告。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: We randomly assigned adults with IgA nephropathy to receive subcutaneous sibeprenlimab (at a dose of 400 mg) or placebo every 4 weeks. The key secondary end point was the annualized slope of the eGFR over 24 months. Other secondary end points included the change in eGFR from baseline to 24 months, a composite kidney end point of kidney-function decline or kidney failure, and pharmacodynamic and safety end points.
abstract.textZh: 我們隨機分配患有IgA腎病的成人每4週接受一次皮下sibeprenlimab （ 400 mg劑量）或安慰劑。次要關鍵終點是24個月內eGFR的年化斜率。其他次要終點包括eGFR從基線到24個月的變化、腎功能下降或腎功能衰竭的複合腎臟終點，以及藥效學和安全性終點。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: A total of 510 patients underwent randomization - 259 to receive sibeprenlimab and 251 to receive placebo. The annualized eGFR slope over 24 months was 0.3 ml per minute per 1.73 m2 of body-surface area per year (95% confidence interval [CI], -0.4 to 0.9) with sibeprenlimab and -4.2 ml per minute per 1.73 m2 per year (95% CI, -4.9 to -3.6) with placebo (between-group difference, 4.5 ml per minute per 1.73 m2 per year; 95% CI, 3.6 to 5.4; P<0.001). The least-squares mean treatment difference for the change in eGFR from baseline to 24 months was 9.2 ml per minute per 1.73 m2 (95% CI, 7.1 to 11.4; P<0.001). A composite kidney end-point event occurred in 1 patient (0.4%) in the sibeprenlimab group and in 28 patients (11.2%) in the placebo group (adjusted difference, -10.8 percentage points; hazard ratio, 0.029; 95% CI, 0.004 to 0.214; P<0.001). Adverse events occurred in 235 patients (90.7%) in the sibeprenlimab group and 226 patients (90.0%) in the placebo group; serious adverse events occurred in 21 patients (8.1%) and 32 patients (12.7%), respectively; and serious infections in 5 patients (1.9%) and 10 patients (4.0%). No deaths were reported.
abstract.textZh: 共有510名患者接受了隨機分組- 259名接受sibeprenlimab ， 251名接受安慰劑。 24個月的年化eGFR斜率為sibeprenlimab每年每1.73 m2身體表面積每分鐘0.3 ml （ 95%置信區間[CI] ， -0.4至0.9 ） ，安慰劑每年每1.73 m2每分鐘-4.2 ml （ 95% CI ， -4.9至-3.6 ） （組間差異，每年每1.73 m2每分鐘4.5 ml ； 95% CI ， 3.6至5.4 ； P < 0.001 ）。 EGFR從基線到24個月變化的最小二乘平均治療差異為每1.73 m2每分鐘9.2 ml (95% CI ， 7.1至11.4 ； P < 0.001)。 Sibeprenlimab組中1名患者(0.4%)和安慰劑組中28名患者(11.2%)發生複合腎終點事件(調整差異， -10.8個百分點；風險比， 0.029 ； 95% CI ， 0.004至0.214 ； P < 0.001)。 不良事件發生在sibeprenlimab組的235名患者（ 90.7% ）和安慰劑組的226名患者（ 90.0% ） ；嚴重不良事件分別發生在21名患者（ 8.1% ）和32名患者（ 12.7% ） ；嚴重感染發生在5名患者（ 1.9% ）和10名患者（ 4.0% ）。 未報告死亡。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: Among patients with IgA nephropathy, treatment with sibeprenlimab stabilized the eGFR slope over 24 months, a finding consistent with a reduced risk of kidney-function decline. (Funded by Otsuka Pharmaceutical Development and Commercialization; VISIONARY ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT05248646.).
abstract.textZh: 在IgA腎病患者中， sibeprenlimab治療在24個月內穩定eGFR斜率，這一發現與腎功能下降的風險降低一致。（由Otsuka Pharmaceutical Development and Commercialization資助； VISIONARY ClinicalTrials.gov編號： NCT05248646。）

articles.title: Atacicept in IgA Nephropathy - Phase 3 Trial Final Efficacy Analysis
articles.authors: Barratt J, Brenner RM, Barbour SJ, Campbell KN, Doan T, Eren N, Floege J, Fordyce MW, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Atacicept resulted in a significantly greater reduction in the urinary protein-to-creatinine ratio than placebo in a previously published analysis of this trial, ORIGIN 3. Final prespecified efficacy results are reported here.
abstract.textZh: 在先前發表的這項試驗（起源3 ）的分析中， Atacicept導致尿蛋白與肌酸酐比率顯著大於安慰劑。此處報告了預先指定的最終療效結果。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: We randomly assigned adults with biopsy-confirmed IgA nephropathy to receive weekly subcutaneous atacicept at a dose of 150 mg or placebo. We carried out final analyses of two secondary end points: the change in the estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) at week 52 and the annualized eGFR slope through week 104; additional hierarchically tested end points and safety were assessed.
abstract.textZh: 我們將活組織檢查確診IgA腎病的成人隨機分配為每週接受150毫克劑量的皮下Atacicept或安慰劑。我們對兩個次要終點進行了最終分析：第52週的估計腎小球過濾率(eGFR)變化和第104週的年化eGFR斜率；評估了其他階層式測試的終點和安全性。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Of 431 patients who underwent randomization, 428 received atacicept or placebo (214 per group). At week 52, the mean change in the eGFR was -0.11 ml per minute per 1.73 m2 of body-surface area (95% confidence interval [CI], -1.44 to 1.22) with atacicept and -5.69 ml per minute per 1.73 m2 (95% CI, -7.04 to -4.35) with placebo (mean difference, 5.58 ml per minute per 1.73 m2; 95% CI, 3.68 to 7.48; P<0.001). Through week 104, the mean annualized eGFR slope was -0.60 ml per minute per 1.73 m2 (95% CI, -1.62 to 0.41) with atacicept and -5.60 ml per minute per 1.73 m2 (95% CI, -6.64 to -4.57) with placebo (difference, 5.00 ml per minute per 1.73 m2 per year; 95% CI, 3.55 to 6.45; P<0.001). Composite kidney-disease progression occurred in 11 patients (5.1%) in the atacicept group and in 38 patients (17.8%) in the placebo group (hazard ratio, 0.24; 95% CI, 0.12 to 0.48; P<0.001); no patients in the atacicept group had progression to dialysis, transplantation, or death, as compared with 7 patients in the placebo group. Adverse events occurred in 160 of 214 patients (74.8%) in the atacicept group and in 167 of 214 patients (78.0%) in the placebo group; serious adverse events occurred in 7.0% and 15.4%, respectively. One patient (in the placebo group) died.
abstract.textZh: 在接受隨機分組的431名患者中， 428名接受atacicept或安慰劑（每組214名）。 在第52週，使用atacicept時， eGFR的平均變化為每1.73 m2身體表面積每分鐘-0.11 ml (95%置信區間[CI] ， -1.44至1.22) ，使用安慰劑時為每1.73 m2每分鐘-5.69 ml (95% CI ， -7.04至-4.35) (平均差值，每1.73 m2每分鐘5.58 ml ； 95% CI ， 3.68至7.48 ； P < 0.001)。 在第104週，平均年化eGFR斜率為-0.60 ml/分鐘/每1.73 m2 (95% CI ， -1.62至0.41) ， atacicept為-5.60 ml/分鐘/每1.73 m2 (95% CI ， -6.64至-4.57) ，安慰劑為-5.60 ml/分鐘/每1.73 m2 (差異， 5.00 ml/分鐘/每年1.73 m2 ； 95% CI ， 3.55至6.45 ； P < 0.001)。 Atacicept組的11名患者(5.1%)和安慰劑組的38名患者(17.8%)發生複合腎臟疾病進展(風險比率， 0.24 ； 95% CI ， 0.12至0.48 ； P < 0.001) ；與安慰劑組的7名患者相比， Atacicept組中沒有患者進展至透析、移植或死亡。 Atacicept組214名患者中有160名（ 74.8% ）發生不良事件，安慰劑組214名患者中有167名（ 78.0% ）發生不良事件；嚴重不良事件發生率分別為7.0%和15.4%。 1名患者（安慰劑組）死亡。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: Atacicept slowed and stabilized the decline in the eGFR as compared with placebo. (Funded by Vera Therapeutics; ORIGIN 3 ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT04716231.).
abstract.textZh: 與安慰劑相比， Atacicept減緩並穩定eGFR的下降。（由Vera Therapeutics資助； ORIGIN 3 ClinicalTrials.gov編號， NCT04716231。）。

articles.title: Helicobacter pylori Infection - Advances, Challenges, and the Road Ahead
articles.authors: Li H, Megraud F, Marshall BJ

abstract.text: The discovery of Helicobacter pylori has revolutionized the prevention and treatment of gastritis, peptic ulcers, and, most important, gastric cancer. In the past 40 years, enormous progress has been achieved in the clinical and basic research on H. pylori infection. However, challenges in preventing and treating H. pylori infection exist owing to the lack of an H. pylori vaccine and the ever-increasing resistance to antibiotics worldwide. This review summarizes the history of and key milestones in H. pylori research, provides an update on the understanding of the pathogenesis and global burden of H. pylori infection and the screening strategy for the primary prevention of gastric cancer, and focuses on the emerging trends in the management of H. pylori infection.
abstract.textZh: 幽門螺旋桿菌的發現徹底改變了胃炎、消化性潰瘍以及最重要的胃癌的預防和治療。在過去40年中，幽門螺旋桿菌感染的臨牀和基礎研究取得了巨大進展。然而，由於缺乏幽門螺旋桿菌疫苗和全球對抗生素的耐藥性不斷增加，在預防和治療幽門螺旋桿菌感染方面存在挑戰。本文總結幽門螺桿菌研究的歷史和關鍵裏程碑，提供對幽門螺桿菌感染發病機制和全球負擔的最新理解，以及胃癌一級預防的篩選策略，並著重於幽門螺桿菌感染管理的新興趨勢。

articles.titleZh: 幽門螺旋桿菌感染-進步、挑戰和未來的道路

articles.title: Ianalumab for the Treatment of Patients with Sjögren's Disease
articles.authors: Mariette X, Grader-Beck T, Finzel S, Schiopu E, Papas A, Devauchelle-Pensec V, Sopala M, Zeng X, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Sjögren's disease is a complex, systemic autoimmune disease with no approved targeted therapies. Ianalumab is an IgG1 monoclonal antibody with a dual mechanism of action, depleting B cells through antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity and inhibiting B-cell activation and survival through blockade of B-cell activating factor receptor.
abstract.textZh: 幹燥病是一種複雜的全身性自身免疫性疾病，沒有獲得批準的靶向療法。Ianalumab是一種IgG1單株抗體，具有雙重作用機制，通過抗體依賴性細胞毒性耗盡B細胞，通過阻斷B細胞活化因子受體抑制B細胞活化和存活。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: We conducted two 52-week, double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled trials involving patients with active Sjögren's disease. Patients in the NEPTUNUS-1 trial were assigned in a 1:1 ratio to receive subcutaneous ianalumab (300 mg monthly) or placebo; patients in the NEPTUNUS-2 trial were assigned in a 1:1:1 ratio to receive 300 mg of ianalumab monthly or every 3 months or placebo. The primary end point was the change from baseline in the score on the European Alliance of Associations for Rheumatology (EULAR) Sjögren's Syndrome Disease Activity Index (ESSDAI) at week 48 (scores range from 0 to 123, with higher scores indicating greater disease activity). The first key secondary end point in the hierarchical plan for the NEPTUNUS-1 trial was an ESSDAI response (≥5-point reduction) at week 48; for the NEPTUNUS-2 trial, it was the change from baseline in the score on the Sjögren's Syndrome Symptom Diary (SSSD) or EULAR Sjögren's Syndrome Patient Reported Index (ESSPRI) at week 48.
abstract.textZh: 我們進行了兩項52週的雙盲、隨機、安慰劑對照試驗，涉及活動性幹燥症患者。NEPTUNUS-1試驗中的患者以1: 1的比例被分配接受皮下ianalumab （每月300毫克）或安慰劑； NEPTUNUS-2試驗中的患者以1: 1: 1的比例被分配接受每月或每3個月或安慰劑300毫克的ianalumab。主要終點是第48週時歐洲風濕病學會聯盟(EULAR)幹燥綜合徵疾病活動指數(ESSDAI)評分與基線相比的變化(評分範圍從0到123 ，較高的評分表示較高的疾病活動)。NEPTUNUS-1試驗階層計劃的第一個關鍵次要終點是第48週的ESSDAI反應（降低≥ 5分） ；對於NEPTUNUS-2試驗，這是第48週的幹燥綜合徵症狀日記（ SSSD ）或EULAR幹燥綜合徵患者報告指數（ ESSPRI ）評分與基線相比的變化。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Overall, 275 patients underwent randomization in the NEPTUNUS-1 trial (ianalumab monthly, 137 patients; placebo, 138 patients) and 504 in the NEPTUNUS-2 trial (ianalumab monthly, 168 patients; ianalumab every 3 months, 167 patients; and placebo, 169 patients). In both trials, ianalumab monthly led to a significantly greater decrease in the ESSDAI score at week 48 than placebo, with a between-group difference of -1.3 points (95% confidence interval [CI], -2.6 to 0.0; P = 0.0496) in NEPTUNUS-1 and -1.0 points (95% CI, -2.0 to 0.0; P = 0.04) in NEPTUNUS-2. No significant differences in the incidence of an ESSDAI response or in the change from baseline in SSSD or ESSPRI scores were observed at week 48. The incidence of serious adverse events was similar with ianalumab and placebo. Nonserious local injection-site and systemic injection-related reactions were more common in the ianalumab groups.
abstract.textZh: 總體而言， 275名患者在NEPTUNUS-1試驗中接受隨機分組（ ianalumab每月137名患者；安慰劑138名患者） ， 504名患者在NEPTUNUS-2試驗中接受隨機分組（ ianalumab每月168名患者； ianalumab每3個月167名患者；安慰劑169名患者）。在這兩項試驗中， ianalumab每月導致第48週的ESSDAI評分顯著大於安慰劑， NEPTUNUS-1的組間差異為-1.3分（ 95%置信區間[CI] ， -2.6至0.0 ； P = 0.0496 ） ， NEPTUNUS-2的組間差異為-1.0分（ 95% CI ， -2.0至0.0 ； P = 0.04 ）。在第48週，未觀察到ESSDAI反應的發生率或SSSD或ESSPRI評分與基線相比的變化有顯著差異。嚴重不良事件的發生率與ianalumab和安慰劑相似。非嚴重局部注射部位和全身注射相關反應在ianalumab組中更為常見。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: In these two trials involving patients with active Sjögren's disease, ianalumab at a dose of 300 mg monthly resulted in a significantly greater decrease in disease activity at week 48 than placebo, although there were no significant differences in the incidence of an ESSDAI response or in the change from baseline in SSSD or ESSPRI symptom scores. (Funded by Novartis Pharma; NEPTUNUS-1 and NEPTUNUS-2 ClinicalTrials.gov numbers, NCT05350072 and NCT05349214, respectively.).
abstract.textZh: 在這兩項涉及活動性幹燥症患者的試驗中， ianalumab每月300毫克的劑量導致第48週的疾病活動顯著大於安慰劑，儘管ESSDAI反應的發生率或SSSD或ESSPRI症狀評分相對於基線的變化沒有顯著差異。（由Novartis Pharma資助； NEPTUNUS-1和NEPTUNUS-2 ClinicalTrials.gov編號、NCT05350072和NCT05349214 ）。

articles.title: Pregnancy Outcomes After Living Kidney Donation
articles.authors: Wang C, Naylor KL, McArthur E, King JA, Sontrop JM, Beyene J, Connaughton D, Hendren E, et al.

abstract.label: IMPORTANCE
abstract.text: People who become pregnant after living kidney donation may be at increased risk of pregnancy-related adverse outcomes, although the evidence is unclear.
abstract.textZh: 活體腎臟捐贈後懷孕的人可能會增加懷孕相關不良結果的風險，儘管證據尚不清楚。

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To determine whether pregnancies after living kidney donation are associated with a higher risk of adverse pregnancy outcomes than matched pregnancies among nondonors.
abstract.textZh: 確定活體腎臟捐贈後的懷孕是否與不良妊娠結果的風險高於非腎臟捐贈者中的匹配懷孕。

abstract.label: DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS
abstract.text: This matched cohort study used provincial administrative health care databases from Ontario, British Columbia, and Alberta, Canada, and included living female kidney donors aged 18 to 42 years who donated a kidney between July 1992 and August 2021 and subsequently had singleton pregnancies of at least 20 weeks' gestation. These pregnancies were matched 1:4 with singleton pregnancies of at least 20 weeks' gestation among female nondonors. Pregnancies in donors and nondonors were matched on delivery date, age at delivery, years between cohort entry and delivery, number of prior pregnancies, and income. Final follow-up occurred until March 2023. Outcome analysis occurred from August 2024 to September 2026.
abstract.textZh: 這項匹配的隊列研究使用了來自安大略省、不列顛哥倫比亞省和加拿大艾伯塔省的省級行政醫療保健數據庫，其中包括18至42歲的活體女性腎臟捐贈者，她們在1992年7月至2021年8月期間捐贈了腎臟，隨後單胎懷孕至少20週。這些懷孕與女性非懷孕者中至少懷孕20週的單胎懷孕1: 4相匹配。捐贈者和非捐贈者的懷孕情況在分娩日期、分娩年齡、隊列進入和分娩之間的年份、先前懷孕的次數和收入上進行了匹配。最終追蹤已進行至2023年3月。結果分析發生在2024年8月至2026年9月。

abstract.label: MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES
abstract.text: The primary outcome was a composite of hospitalization with a diagnosis of gestational hypertension, preeclampsia, or eclampsia. Secondary outcomes included 12 maternal, fetal and neonatal adverse outcomes, including the individual components of the primary outcome, the composite of low birth weight or preterm birth, and small for gestational age at birth.
abstract.textZh: 主要結果是住院綜合診斷為妊娠高血壓、子癇前期或子癇。次要結果包括12個母體、胎兒和新生兒不良結果，包括主要結果的個別組成部分、低出生體重或早產的綜合結果，以及出生時胎齡較小的結果。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: The sample included 385 pregnancies in 252 living kidney donors (mean [SD] age, 27.8 [5.0] years) matched to 1540 pregnancies in 1535 nondonors (mean [SD] age, 27.0 [4.8] years). The primary composite outcome of gestational hypertension, preeclampsia, or eclampsia occurred in 46 donor pregnancies (11.9%) and 128 nondonor pregnancies (8.3%; risk ratio, 1.51; 95% CI, 1.10-2.08). Among the 12 secondary outcomes, the 95% CI for the risk ratio excluded 1.00 for the outcome of small for gestational age, which occurred in 53 donor pregnancies (13.8%) and 121 nondonor pregnancies (7.9%) (risk ratio, 1.86; 95% CI, 1.37-2.52).
abstract.textZh: 樣本包括252名活體腎臟捐贈者的385次懷孕（平均[SD]年齡， 27.8 [5.0]歲） ，與1535名非腎臟捐贈者的1540次懷孕（平均[SD]年齡， 27.0 [4.8]歲）相匹配。妊娠高血壓、子癇前期或子癇的主要綜合結果發生在46次供體懷孕（ 11.9% ）和128次非懷孕（ 8.3% ；風險比為1.51 ； 95% CI為1.10-2.08 ）。在12個次要結果中，風險比的95% CI排除了小胎齡結果的1.00 ，發生在53次供體懷孕（ 13.8% ）和121次非供體懷孕（ 7.9% ） （風險比， 1.86 ； 95% CI ， 1.37-2.52 ）。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE
abstract.text: In this study, pregnancy after living kidney donation was associated with a higher risk of the composite outcome of hospitalization with a diagnosis of gestational hypertension, preeclampsia, or eclampsia, when compared with matched pregnancies in nondonors. Most postdonation pregnancies were uncomplicated. These findings support counseling donor candidates who may become pregnant about this risk and informing the prenatal care of donors who become pregnant.
abstract.textZh: 在這項研究中，活體腎臟捐贈後的懷孕與診斷為妊娠高血壓、先兆子癇或子癇的住院綜合結果的風險較高。大多數用藥後懷孕並不複雜。這些發現支持諮詢可能懷孕的捐贈者候選人關於這種風險，並告知懷孕捐贈者的產前護理。

articles.titleZh: 活體腎臟捐贈後的妊娠結果

articles.title: Rituximab vs Azathioprine for Eosinophilic Granulomatosis With Polyangiitis Maintenance Therapy: A Randomized Clinical Trial
articles.authors: Puéchal X, Pugnet G, Thoreau B, de Moreuil C, Jouneau S, Quéméneur T, Baron G, Smets P, et al.

abstract.label: IMPORTANCE
abstract.text: For patients with eosinophilic granulomatosis with polyangiitis (EGPA), guidelines recommend considering maintenance therapy after achieving remission. Data comparing maintenance therapeutic options are limited.
abstract.textZh: 對於嗜酸性肉芽腫病伴多血管炎(EGPA)的患者，指南建議在緩解後考慮維持治療。比較維持治療選項的數據有限。

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To compare the effects of rituximab and azathioprine maintenance therapies on remission duration for patients with EGPA who recently achieved remission of vasculitis after standard therapy, including prednisone tapering or withdrawal.
abstract.textZh: 比較利妥昔單抗和硫唑嘌呤維持療法對最近在標準療法（包括強的鬆逐漸減少或停藥）後達到血管炎緩解的EGPA患者緩解持續時間的影響。

abstract.label: DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS
abstract.text: From March 7, 2018, to June 2, 2022, this double-blind, double-dummy, investigator-initiated, superiority, randomized clinical trial enrolled 98 participants with EGPA from 36 hospitals in France. Inclusion eligibility required a new EGPA diagnosis or relapsing EGPA within 30 to 360 days of achieving vasculitis remission (Birmingham Vasculitis Activity Score of 0 [range, 0-63, with higher scores indicating more severe disease activity]) after a standard induction regimen. Data were analyzed from April 1, 2025, to September 17, 2025. Additional analyses ended June 22, 2026.
abstract.textZh: 從2018年3月7日至2022年6月2日，這項雙盲、雙假、研究者主導、優越性、隨機臨牀試驗招募了來自法國36家醫院的98名EGPA參與者。納入資格要求在達到血管炎緩解後30至360天內進行新的EGPA診斷或復發性EGPA （伯明翰血管炎活動評分為0 [範圍， 0-63 ，較高評分表示更嚴重的疾病活動] ）。分析了2025年4月1日至2025年9月17日的數據。其他分析已於2026年6月22日結束。

abstract.label: INTERVENTIONS
abstract.text: Participants were randomized to receive a predefined standardized tapering of oral prednisone and either 500 mg of intravenous rituximab every 6 months for 18 months and daily oral azathioprine placebo for 24 months (n = 49) or rituximab placebo every 6 months for 18 months and daily oral azathioprine for 24 months (n = 49).
abstract.textZh: 參與者被隨機分配接受預先定義的口服強的鬆和每6個月500毫克靜脈注射利妥昔單抗，持續18個月，每天口服硫唑嘌呤安慰劑，持續24個月(n = 49) ，或每6個月口服利妥昔單抗安慰劑，持續18個月，每天口服硫唑嘌呤24個月(n = 49)。

abstract.label: MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES
abstract.text: The primary efficacy end point was the duration of total remission during the 28-month study period while taking 7.5 mg/d or less of prednisone. The 14 secondary end points included proportion of participants remaining in remission, rate of vasculitis relapse, and rate of asthma or rhinosinusitis exacerbations.
abstract.textZh: 主要療效終點是服用7.5 mg/d或更少強的鬆時，在28個月研究期間的總緩解持續時間。14個次要終點包括仍處於緩解期的參與者比例、血管炎復發率以及哮喘或鼻竇炎惡化率。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: All 98 randomized participants (mean age, 59.0 years [SD, 14.4]; 50 women [51%]) received at least 1 dose of the trial regimen and 92 (94%) completed the trial. The mean time in remission with prednisone at 7.5 mg/d or less was 91.1 weeks (95% CI, 80.9-101.2) vs 96.0 weeks (95% CI, 85.6-106.5) in the rituximab and azathioprine groups, respectively (P = .38). The proportion of participants who remained in remission during the 28-month study period with prednisone at 7.5 mg/d or less was 17 of 49 (34.7%) vs 11 of 49 (22.4%; relative risk, 1.51; 95% CI, 0.83-2.73; P = .18) in the rituximab and azathioprine groups, respectively. The proportion of participants with at least 1 vasculitis relapse was 7 (14.3%) vs 9 (18.4%) in the rituximab vs azathioprine groups, respectively, and for those with at least 1 clinically significant asthma exacerbation, rhinosinusitis exacerbation, or both, it was 16 (32.7%) vs 19 (38.8%). One participant in the azathioprine group died of SARS-CoV-2 infection before vaccine development. Rituximab recipients experienced a higher incidence of severe infections (23 [46.9%] vs 12 [24.5%], respectively), primarily due to severe SARS-CoV-2 infections.
abstract.textZh: 所有98名隨機參與者（平均年齡59.0歲[SD ， 14.4] ； 50名婦女[51%] ）接受了至少1劑試驗方案， 92名（ 94% ）完成了試驗。 以7.5 mg/d或更低濃度使用強的鬆的平均緩解時間為91.1週（ 95% CI ， 80.9-101.2 ） ，而利妥昔單抗和硫唑嘌呤組的平均緩解時間為96.0週（ 95% CI ， 85.6-106.5 ） （ P = 0.38 ）。 利妥昔單抗和硫唑嘌呤組在28個月研究期間使用7.5 mg/d或更低的強的鬆保持緩解的參與者比例分別為17/49 （ 34.7% ）和11/49 （ 22.4% ；相對風險， 1.51 ； 95% CI ， 0.83-2.73 ； P = 0.18 ）。 利妥昔單抗組與硫唑嘌呤組中至少有1次血管炎復發的參與者比例分別為7 （ 14.3 ％ ）與9 （ 18.4 ％ ） ，而對於至少有1次臨牀顯著哮喘急性發作、鼻竇炎急性發作或兩者兼有的參與者，比例為16 （ 32.7 ％ ）與19 （ 38.8 ％ ）。 硫唑嘌呤組的一名參與者在疫苗開發前死於SARS-CoV-2感染。 利妥昔單抗受者的嚴重感染發生率較高（分別為23 [46.9%]對12 [24.5%] ） ，主要是由於嚴重的SARS-CoV-2感染。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE
abstract.text: For participants with newly diagnosed or relapsing EGPA, rituximab was not superior to azathioprine for improving the duration of total remission during 28 months while taking prednisone at 7.5 mg/d or less.
abstract.textZh: 對於新診斷或復發EGPA的參與者，利妥昔單抗在改善28個月期間的總緩解持續時間方面並不優於硫唑嘌呤，同時服用7.5 mg/d或更少的強的鬆。

articles.title: Childhood Cancer Risk After Assisted Reproductive Technology
articles.authors: Mose K, Kjaer SK, Jensen A, Grell K, Pottegård A, Hargreave M

abstract.label: IMPORTANCE
abstract.text: Childhood cancer risk after assisted reproductive technology (ART) remains uncertain, particularly by procedure and cancer type.
abstract.textZh: 輔助生殖技術（ ART ）後的兒童癌症風險仍然不確定，特別是手術和癌症類型。

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To examine associations between ART and childhood cancer overall and by ART modality and cancer type.
abstract.textZh: 檢查ART與整體兒童癌症之間的關聯，並按ART模式和癌症類型進行檢查。

abstract.label: DESIGN, SETTING, AND POPULATION
abstract.text: Nationwide Danish cohort of 1 086 136 live-born children from 1996 to 2012, of whom 37 228 (3.4%) were conceived using ART, with follow-up through 2023.
abstract.textZh: 從1996年到2012年，全國共有1 086 136名活產兒童，其中37 228 （ 3.4 ％ ）是使用ART懷孕的，隨訪至2023年。

abstract.label: EXPOSURES
abstract.text: Maternal ART, classified as in vitro fertilization (IVF), intracytoplasmic sperm injection, or frozen embryo transfer.
abstract.textZh: 母體藝術，分類為體外受精（ IVF ）、胞漿內精子注射或冷凍胚胎移植。

abstract.label: MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES
abstract.text: Incident childhood cancer. Cox proportional hazards models estimated hazard ratios (HRs); Poisson models estimated incidence rates. Non-ART births were the primary reference; secondary analyses used children of women with a history of infertility and children conceived using IVF as reference groups.
abstract.textZh: 兒童癌症發病率。Cox比例風險模型估計風險比率（ HR ） ；泊鬆模型估計發病率。非ART分娩是主要參考資料；次要分析使用有不育史的婦女的子女和使用IVF作為參考組懷孕的子女。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: During a median follow-up of 20 years, 3736 cancers occurred. Compared with non-ART births (incidence rate, 18.3 per 100 000 person-years), children conceived using ART had higher cancer incidence (incidence rate, 23.6 per 100 000; HR, 1.26 [95% CI, 1.07-1.48]). Rates were higher after frozen embryo transfer (incidence rate, 41.1 per 100 000; HR, 2.18 [95% CI, 1.45-3.29]) and intracytoplasmic sperm injection (incidence rate, 27.9 per 100 000; HR, 1.48 [95% CI, 1.16-1.89]) but not IVF (incidence rate, 18.5 per 100 000; HR, 1.01 [95% CI, 0.79-1.28]). Frozen embryo transfer was associated with leukemia (incidence rate, 11.1 per 100 000; HR, 2.36 [95% CI, 1.06-5.28]), lymphomas (HR, 3.03 [95% CI, 1.13-8.12]), and soft tissue sarcomas (HR, 7.63 [95% CI, 2.82-20.62]); intracytoplasmic sperm injection was associated with lymphomas (incidence rate, 4.6 per 100 000; HR, 1.94 [95% CI, 1.07-3.54]), soft tissue sarcomas (incidence rate, 3.3 per 100 000; HR, 3.28 [95% CI, 1.54-7.00]), and central nervous system neoplasms (incidence rate, 8.2 per 100 000; HR, 1.63 [95% CI, 1.04-2.57]); no associations were observed for IVF. Findings were similar in secondary analyses using children of women with a history of infertility and children conceived using IVF as reference groups.
abstract.textZh: 在20年的中位隨訪期間，發生了3736例癌症。 與非ART分娩（發生率，每10萬人年18.3 ）相比，使用ART懷孕的兒童具有更高的癌症發生率（發生率，每10萬人年23.6 ； HR ， 1.26 [95% CI ， 1.07-1.48] ）。 冷凍胚胎移植後的發生率較高（發生率為每10萬人41.1例； HR ， 2.18 [95% CI ， 1.45-3.29] ）和胞漿內精子注射（發生率為每10萬人27.9例； HR ， 1.48 [95% CI ， 1.16-1.89] ） ，但不是IVF （發生率為每10萬人18.5例； HR ， 1.01 [95% CI ， 0.79-1.28] ）。 冷凍胚胎移植與白血病(發生率， 11.1/100 000 ； HR ， 2.36 [95% CI ， 1.06-5.28])、淋巴瘤(HR ， 3.03 [95% CI ， 1.13-8.12])和軟組織肉瘤(HR ， 7.63 [95% CI ， 2.82-20.62])相關；胞漿內精子注射與淋巴瘤(發生率， 4.6/100 000 ； HR ， 1.94 [95% CI ， 1.07-3.54])、軟組織肉瘤(發生率， 3.3/100 000 ； HR ， 3.28 [95% CI ， 1.54-7.00])和中樞神經系統腫瘤(發生率， 8.2/100 000 ； HR ， 1.63 [95% CI ， 1.04-2.57])相關；未觀察到IVF相關。 在使用有不育史的婦女的兒童和使用IVF作為參考組懷孕的兒童的次要分析中，結果相似。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE
abstract.text: ART, particularly frozen embryo transfer and intracytoplasmic sperm injection, was associated with increased childhood cancer risk, but absolute risks were low. The consistent results in secondary analyses of children with maternal infertility history or conceived via IVF suggest that procedure-related, rather than infertility-related, factors warrant further investigation.
abstract.textZh: ART ，特別是冷凍胚胎移植和胞漿內精子注射，與兒童癌症風險增加有關，但絕對風險很低。對有母體不育史或通過IVF懷孕的兒童進行的二級分析的一致結果表明，與手術相關而非與不育相關的因素值得進一步研究。

articles.title: Overuse and False Restraint in Large Language Model Recommendations for Choosing Wisely Scenarios
articles.authors: Ariel D, Endelman S, Laban G

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: The Choosing Wisely initiative made recommendations where screening, testing, or treatment may be overused, with caveats around appropriate use. Clinicians are increasingly using large language models (LLMs).
abstract.textZh: 「明智選擇」計劃提出了可能過度使用篩選、測試或治療的建議，並對適當使用提出了警告。臨牀醫生越來越多地使用大型語言模型（ LLM ）。

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To evaluate whether commercial LLMs appropriately call for restraint or action from scenarios based on Choosing Wisely recommendations.
abstract.textZh: 根據明智選擇的建議，評估商業LLM是否適當地要求情境中的克制或行動。

abstract.label: DESIGN
abstract.text: Benchmark evaluation. Fifteen Choosing Wisely recommendations were used to develop 225 scenarios (per recommendation, 10 in which restraint was appropriate and 5 in which action was appropriate). Six commercial LLMs (3 runs each) generated 4050 responses to the 225 scenarios, using a prompt from the clinician perspective.
abstract.textZh: 基準評估。使用15個明智選擇建議來制定225個情境（根據建議，其中10個是適當的限制， 5個是適當的行動）。六個商業LLM （每個運行3次）使用臨牀醫生的提示對225個情境產生了4050個回應。

abstract.label: SETTING
abstract.text: Production application programming interfaces of OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google from February to March 2026.
abstract.textZh: 2026年2月至3月， OpenAI、Anthropic和Google的生產應用程式設計介面。

abstract.label: PARTICIPANTS
abstract.text: No human participants were involved.
abstract.textZh: 沒有人類參與。

abstract.label: MEASUREMENTS
abstract.text: Co-primary outcomes were the overuse rate (endorsing action when restraint was appropriate) and the false restraint rate (withholding an appropriate action).
abstract.textZh: 共同主要結果是過度使用率（在適當時批準採取行動）和錯誤限制率（不採取適當行動）。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: The rate of LLM-recommended overuse was 5.4% (95% CI, 0.6% to 12.2%); LLMs did not recommend overuse in 8 of 15 recommendations. Two recommendations accounted for most LLM-recommended overuse: thyroid ultrasound for an incidental subcentimeter nodule (overuse recommended in 42.8% of LLM responses) and routine electrocardiography in low-risk adults (overuse recommended in 28.3% of LLM responses). The LLMs recommended overuse in 0.6% to 3.3% of responses for the remaining 5 recommendations. False restraint was rare (0.6% [CI, 0.1% to 1.2%]), was absent for 11 of 15 recommendations, and was highest for prostate-specific antigen screening (3.3%).
abstract.textZh: LLM建議過度使用率為5.4% （ 95% CI ， 0.6%至12.2% ） ； 15項建議中有8項LLM不建議過度使用。兩項建議解釋了大多數LLM建議過度使用的原因：針對附帶的次公分結節進行甲狀腺超聲檢查（ 42.8%的LLM回應中建議過度使用） ，以及針對低風險成人進行常規心電圖檢查（ 28.3%的LLM回應中建議過度使用）。LLM建議過度使用，其餘5項建議的回應為0.6%至3.3%。錯誤限制很少見（ 0.6% [CI ， 0.1%至1.2%] ） ， 15項建議中有11項不存在，前列腺特異性抗原篩選最高（ 3.3% ）。

abstract.label: LIMITATIONS
abstract.text: Single prompts without follow-up; a benchmark rather than real-world use; responses classified by LLM judge with physician adjudication. Findings may not extend to consumer-facing use.
abstract.textZh: 沒有追蹤的單次提示；基準而非實際使用；由LLM法官歸類並由醫生裁定的回應。調查結果可能無法延伸至面向消費者的使用。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: The LLMs rarely withheld recommendations for treatment when it was appropriate. Overuse was concentrated in 2 recommendations.
abstract.textZh: 法學碩士很少在適當的時候隱瞞治療建議。過度使用集中在2個建議。

abstract.label: PRIMARY FUNDING SOURCE
abstract.text: None.
abstract.textZh: 無。

articles.title: Diagnosis and Treatment of Cardiovascular Conditions in Medicare Advantage In-Home Health Risk Assessments
articles.authors: Oseran AS, Liu-Hass M, Shanab BM, Zheng Z, Lalani C, Yeh RW, Wadhera RK

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Medicare Advantage insurers conduct in-home health risk assessments (HRAs) to identify high-risk patients and facilitate appropriate care. Critics argue this practice increases risk-adjusted payments without improving quality. Comprehensive data on use of in-home HRAs and downstream treatment are lacking.
abstract.textZh: Medicare Advantage保險公司進行居家健康風險評估（ HRA ） ，以識別高風險患者並促進適當的護理。批評者認為，這種做法會增加風險調整後的付款，而不會提高質量。缺乏有關居家HRA和下遊治療使用的綜合數據。

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To examine trends in cardiovascular conditions diagnosed during in-home HRAs, characteristics associated with HRA-based diagnoses, and treatment rates after diagnoses.
abstract.textZh: 檢查在居家HRA期間診斷的心血管疾病趨勢、與基於HRA的診斷相關的特徵，以及診斷後的治療率。

abstract.label: DESIGN
abstract.text: Cohort study.
abstract.textZh: 世代研究。）

abstract.label: SETTING
abstract.text: Population-based.
abstract.textZh: 以人羣為基礎。

abstract.label: PARTICIPANTS
abstract.text: Medicare Advantage beneficiaries.
abstract.textZh: Medicare Advantage受益人。

abstract.label: MEASUREMENTS
abstract.text: Using 100% Medicare claims, trends in the proportion of cardiovascular conditions diagnosed during in-home HRAs (vs. facility-based visits) were examined. Multivariable logistic regression models were fit to estimate the association between beneficiary- and plan-level characteristics and HRA-based diagnoses and compare treatment rates across settings.
abstract.textZh: 使用100 ％ Medicare索賠，檢查了在家中HRA期間診斷出心血管疾病比例的趨勢（與基於設施的就診）。多變量邏輯回歸模型適用於估計受益人和計劃水平特徵與基於HRA的診斷之間的關聯，並比較不同環境下的治療率。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Among 21 496 506 Medicare Advantage beneficiaries diagnosed with a cardiovascular risk factor or disease, the proportion diagnosed during in-home HRAs increased between 2018 and 2022 for hypertension (45.9% to 47.7%), hyperlipidemia (57.8% to 66.7%), diabetes (47.8% to 51.6%), atrial fibrillation (30.0% to 36.0%), ischemic heart disease (37.2% to 41.6%), peripheral vascular disease (64.5% to 73.9%), and heart failure (34.7% to 42.6%). Racial and ethnic minority beneficiaries and those enrolled in lower-rated plans were more likely to receive HRA-based diagnoses. Treatment rates were substantially lower after HRA-based diagnoses across all conditions.
abstract.textZh: 在被診斷患有心血管疾病的21,496,506名Medicare Advantage受益人中，在2018年至2022年期間，在家中HRA中診斷出高血壓（ 45.9 ％至47.7 ％ ）、高脂血症（ 57.8 ％至66.7 ％ ）、糖尿病（ 47.8 ％至51.6 ％ ）、心房顫動（ 30.0 ％至36.0 ％ ）、缺血性心臟病（ 37.2 ％至41.6 ％ ）、外周血管疾病（ 64.5 ％至73.9 ％ ）和心力衰竭（ 34.7 ％至42.6 ％ ）的比例有所增加。種族和少數族裔受益人以及參加低評級計劃的人更有可能接受基於HRA的診斷。在所有病症的基於HRA的診斷後，治療率顯著降低。

abstract.label: LIMITATIONS
abstract.text: Differences in the severity of conditions between groups could not be assessed. Prescription fills were used as a proxy for management. Observed differences in the diagnosis and treatment of conditions across encounter settings may be susceptible to unmeasured confounding.
abstract.textZh: 無法評估各組之間病情嚴重程度的差異。處方藥填充物用作管理的代用品。在不同遭遇情況下的病症診斷和治療中觀察到的差異可能容易產生無法測量的混淆。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Among Medicare Advantage beneficiaries, an increasingly large share of cardiovascular conditions are being diagnosed through in-home HRAs, but treatment rates after these diagnoses are consistently lower than after facility-based encounters.
abstract.textZh: 在Medicare Advantage受益人中，越來越多的心血管疾病正在通過居家HRA進行診斷，但這些診斷後的治療率始終低於設施接觸後的治療率。

abstract.text: National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute.

articles.title: Projected Effect of 2026 Federal Changes to the Childhood Immunization Schedule on Chronic Hepatitis B Virus Infections in the United States
articles.authors: Mohareb AM, Ganapathi L, Dugdale CM, Rajbhandari R, Ciaranello A, Neilan AM, Jhaveri R, Kim AY, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: The United States recently proposed changes to the recommendations for childhood hepatitis B virus (HBV) vaccination.
abstract.textZh: 美國最近提議修改兒童乙型肝炎病毒（ HBV ）疫苗接種的建議。

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To project the effect of vaccine policy changes, if fully implemented, on chronic HBV infections.
abstract.textZh: 預測疫苗政策變化（如果完全實施）對慢性HBV感染的影響。

abstract.label: DESIGN
abstract.text: Markov cohort state transition model of perinatal and childhood HBV infection.
abstract.textZh: 圍生期和兒童期HBV感染的馬爾可夫隊列狀態轉換模型。

abstract.label: DATA SOURCES
abstract.text: Published data on maternal HBV prevalence (0.4%) and hepatitis B surface antigen testing (99.5% sensitivity), childhood vaccine completion (universal birth-dose strategy: 91.1%; deferred strategy: 87.1%; shared decision-making strategy: 50.0%), and age-stratified risk for chronic HBV infection.
abstract.textZh: 發表了關於母體HBV患病率（ 0.4% ）和乙型肝炎表面抗原檢測（ 99.5%敏感性）、兒童疫苗完成率（普遍出生劑量策略： 91.1% ；延遲策略： 87.1% ；共同決策策略： 50.0% ）以及慢性HBV感染年齡分層風險的數據。

abstract.label: TARGET POPULATION
abstract.text: One-year birth cohort of U.S.-born infants (n = 3.6 million).
abstract.textZh: 美國出生嬰兒的一年出生羣組（ n = 360萬）。

abstract.label: TIME HORIZON
abstract.text: 20 years.

abstract.label: INTERVENTION
abstract.text: Universal birth-dose vaccination, deferred (2-month) vaccination, and vaccination through shared decision making.
abstract.textZh: 普及出生劑量疫苗接種、延遲（ 2個月）疫苗接種，以及透過共同決策進行疫苗接種。

abstract.label: OUTCOME MEASURES
abstract.text: Numbers with chronic HBV infection and susceptibility to HBV, with 95% uncertainty intervals (UIs) derived from probabilistic sensitivity analysis.
abstract.textZh: 慢性HBV感染和HBV易感性的數字， 95%的不確定性區間(UI)來自概率敏感性分析。

abstract.label: RESULTS OF BASE-CASE ANALYSIS
abstract.text: Compared with the universal birth-dose strategy (255 childhood infections [95% UI, 130 to 530]), the deferred and shared decision-making strategies would increase chronic HBV infections in the 2026 birth cohort by 19% to 303 (95% UI, 155 to 610) and by 83% to 467 (95% UI, 209 to 1032), respectively. These strategies would also increase the number of HBV-susceptible people at year 20 (474 000 and 1 806 000) compared with the universal birth-dose strategy (232 000).
abstract.textZh: 與通用出生劑量策略（ 255例兒童感染[95% UI ， 130至530] ）相比，延遲和共享決策策略將使2026年出生隊列中的慢性HBV感染分別增加19%至303例（ 95% UI ， 155至610例）和83%至467例（ 95% UI ， 209至1032例）。與普遍出生劑量策略（ 232 000 ）相比，這些策略還將增加20年時HBV易感人羣的數量（ 474 000和1 806 000 ）。

abstract.label: RESULTS OF SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS
abstract.text: In a scenario with lower vaccine coverage (84.5%) and higher HBV prevalence (maternal prevalence of 0.72% and higher risk for horizontal infection), chronic HBV infections would increase to 1700 and 2192, respectively, with the deferred and shared decision-making strategies.
abstract.textZh: 在疫苗覆蓋率較低（ 84.5 ％ ）和HBV流行率較高的情況下（母體流行率為0.72 ％ ，橫向感染風險較高） ，通過延遲和共享決策策策略，慢性HBV感染將分別增加到1700和2192。

abstract.label: LIMITATION
abstract.text: Uncertainty in horizontal HBV infection risk.
abstract.textZh: 水平HBV感染風險的不確定性。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Proposed policy changes for vaccination through shared decision making are projected to result in an 83% increase in childhood HBV infections, and between 50% and 70% of children entering adulthood annually would be susceptible to HBV infection. Policymakers should reimplement recommendations for universal birth-dose vaccination.
abstract.textZh: 通過共同決策進行疫苗接種的擬議政策變化預計將導致兒童乙肝病毒感染增加83 ％ ，每年進入成年期的兒童中有50 ％至70 ％容易感染乙肝病毒。決策者應重新實施普及出生劑量疫苗接種的建議。

abstract.text: National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases.
